trap.label: look forward to
trap.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
trap.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
trap.why: Em português “aguardo ouvir” usa infinitivo. Em inglês, to em look forward to é preposição e pede -ing.

opts: I look forward to hearing from you.

mcq.q: “I would be grateful ___ you could renew it.”

opts: I am writing in response to…

fix.wrong: I am writing for ask about the loan.
fix.right: I am writing to ask about the loan.

fix.wrong: I would be grateful if you could to renew it.
fix.right: I would be grateful if you could renew it.

fix.wrong: The reason is because the library closes.
fix.right: The reason is that the library closes.
